order_book: Order book, INR162 crores, 13,138 tons as of June 30th, more than one quarter of revenue.
guidance: So, what we are targeting is that we will spend around INR80 crores in capex in the current year.
Aakarsh Goyal: Yes, we are targeting INR80 crores of capex in the current financial year.
capex: Melting capacity is 1.5x what it was in FY24, and the INR63 crores of IPO capex goes into the platform for the next leg.
Capacity utilization was 90.5%: 94% in the melt shop, 87.5% in the rolling mill.
focus: Melting has been in the mid-90s for almost 2 years, which is why we are adding capacity.
Fourth, cost and capabilities: the solar project will bring down our power cost, a NABL- accredited lab coming up to shorten the customer qualification, and the defense sector is a new vertical.
Import substitution in rolls, where we are the only domestic player adding capacity.
